The `GET /api/owners/{ownerId}` response is built from the generated `OwnerDto` via `OwnerMapper.toOwnerDto(...)`, so `initials` belongs there alongside the existing computed `displayName` field.

**`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `initials` property to the `Owner` schema (the source `OwnerDto` is generated from this spec), documented to match the spec.

```java
default String initials(Owner owner) {
    return Character.toUpperCase(owner.getFirstName().charAt(0)) + "."
        + Character.toUpperCase(owner.getLastName().charAt(0)) + ".";
}
```

`AcceptanceTest.coreComputesInitials` (john/smith → `J.S.`) and the full suite pass.
